Definition: Attai, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Three men bear the name Attai, and the record keeps each one in his own place. One was the son of Jarha the Egyptian, born to Sheshan's daughter, one was a Gadite captain who joined David at Ziklag, and one was the son of Rehoboam and Maachah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three Attais show how the record honours men in very different stations, a servant's son, a soldier, and a king's son, and God counts them all.
RelatedPeople: Attai, Son of Jarha; Attai the Gadite; Attai, Son of Rehoboam; King David; Rehoboam
